summary: TASK_CLOSE run on the SGSR1-enlarge feature (branch feat/dlssnr-sgsr1-upscale). Feature went through 3 rounds of in-game bug reports/fixes after the plan's own 10/10 steps shipped: proxy/answer detail-basis mismatch, one-instance-per-frame reuse bug, Neutwo/Hybrid domain-decode bug (plus a self-caught highlight-clipping regression in the first attempt at that fix), and finally a structural (not-a-bug) explanation for Replace mode's resolution ceiling below 100% model resolution -- confirmed via direct in-game A/B (Composed fine, Replace still soft, same resolution). Also mapped the full DLSS-NR render pipeline as docs/DLSSNR-SIGNAL-PATH.html (published as a Claude artifact too), which surfaced two further findings: the proxy downsample was averaging in gamma/curve-encoded space instead of true linear light (fixed, incl. a new SoftKneeDecode -- exact for the knee's luminance roll-off, approximate for its non-invertible peak-clamp), and 'Matched residual' (DlssNrTransfer) is now a no-op whenever the enlarge stage succeeds (not fixed, flagged only). User confirmed the downsample fix tested OK in-game. Verified and promoted: 1 architecture_overview.md entry (pipeline map pointer + SGSR1 enlarge + Replace-mode resolution-ceiling fact) and 5 known_gotchas.md entries (two-buffer edit-math matching, one-Dispatch-per-frame instance rule, SoftKnee's lossy peak-clamp, cbuffer-fields-default-to-zero trap, Matched-residual's now-narrower scope). Task file archived. Nothing on this branch is committed yet.
